instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a full shot at eye-level on a sunny sandy beach with ocean waves in the background. The woman in the dark brown bikini (R1) stands on the left, raising her left hand to high-five the woman in the teal bikini top and patterned bottoms (R2) on the right. The woman (R2) balances on one leg with her other leg extended to the side, raising her right hand to meet the high-five. Both women are smiling and looking at each other. A surfboard and paddle lie on the sand in the foreground between them. Warm, bright afternoon sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the sand.
